# ClawBox Documentation

> ClawBox is pre-configured AI hardware (NVIDIA Jetson) running OpenClaw OS — a self-hosted AI assistant reachable from Telegram and the web. This documentation covers consumer setup, deep technical reference, troubleshooting, and recovery. Site: https://docs.clawbox.com · Source: https://github.com/ID-Robots/clawbox (docs live in docs-site/, releases are vX.Y.Z tags on main, integration branch is beta).

Key facts: web UI at http://<box-ip> port 80 (never :18789 — that's the token-gated gateway; it loads but rejects passwords); a default-deny inbound firewall (ufw) ships on the device — only 22/tcp SSH, 80/tcp web UI, 443/tcp HTTPS when certs are installed, 18789/tcp gateway (nothing listens there on Hermes) and, on Hermes/dual, 8090/tcp are reachable, and only from private LAN ranges (plus 5353/udp mDNS from anywhere and the hotspot's own DHCP/DNS); 631 CUPS, 111 rpcbind and 3006 (the raw, unauthenticated terminal PTY — use /terminal-ws on port 80) are closed to the LAN; one Linux password (`clawbox` user) for both SSH and browser login; device state in /home/clawbox/clawbox/data and, per edition, ~/.openclaw or ~/.hermes (survives updates; wiped by factory reset, except data/network.env, data/llamacpp/models and ~/.hermes/hermes-agent); updates are git-tag based and reboot the box at the end; provider credentials live in ~/.openclaw/agents/main/agent/auth-profiles.json.

## Start Here

- [Quick Reference](https://docs.clawbox.com/technical/quick-reference): the one-page fact sheet — ports, paths, services, commands, endpoints, gotchas. Best single page for agents.
- [ClawBox Overview](https://docs.clawbox.com/): what ClawBox is, models, pricing
- [Quickstart](https://docs.clawbox.com/quickstart): unbox → power → talk

## Setup

- [First Boot](https://docs.clawbox.com/setup/first-boot): unbox, join the ClawBox-Setup hotspot (open, 10.42.0.1 / fallback 10.43.0.1), run the 5-step browser wizard (Wi-Fi → update → password → AI provider → optional Telegram) — the first-run guide. There is NO QR-code pairing; the only QR in the product opens Telegram's @BotFather
- [Connect to a Network](https://docs.clawbox.com/setup/connect-network): joining Wi-Fi or Ethernet after setup
- [Choose Your AI Provider](https://docs.clawbox.com/setup/choose-ai-provider): ClawBox AI, Claude, GPT, Gemini, OpenRouter, local models
- [OpenClaw Setup](https://docs.clawbox.com/setup/openclaw-setup): gateway configuration

## Editions

- [Editions](https://docs.clawbox.com/editions/overview): the three editions (openclaw | hermes | dual), chosen at flash time and recorded in the root-owned /etc/clawbox/edition.env; no `clawbox` command is installed — run `bun run /home/clawbox/clawbox/mcp/clawbox-cli.ts edition` to print it
- [Hermes Edition](https://docs.clawbox.com/editions/hermes): Hermes Agent as the only agent — no OpenClaw gateway (unit masked, :18789 closed, /api/* and /chat 404), no App Store or Control UI, Skills + Hermes dashboard instead; the CLI update path is refused on this edition, use Settings → System Update. ClawKeep backups are not available on this edition. There is no VS Code / code-server app on ANY edition — it was removed from the product
- [AI Providers on Hermes](https://docs.clawbox.com/editions/hermes-providers): the Hermes models panel — sign-in vs API-key providers, ClawBox AI as a custom provider, on-device Gemma 4 with standby and a two-state Thinking off/on switch, eight reasoning levels for effort-scale providers (seven on ClawBox AI — no Ultra)
- [Hermes Skills](https://docs.clawbox.com/editions/hermes-skills): the capability store replacing the App Store; offline catalogue; install takes a full identifier, uninstall takes the short name; skills live in ~/.hermes/skills

## Technical Reference

- [System Architecture](https://docs.clawbox.com/technical/architecture): service topology, request routing, boot lifecycle, and how the OS relates to its AI harness (OpenClaw on openclaw/dual, Hermes on hermes/dual)
- [Networking](https://docs.clawbox.com/technical/networking): AP mode (no DNS hijack — dnsmasq forwards upstream; the middleware answers captive-portal probe paths), mDNS/clawbox.local reliability, full port map, remote access via /setup-api/portal/*, portal heartbeat
- [Filesystem Layout](https://docs.clawbox.com/technical/filesystem): where everything lives; what survives updates vs factory reset; where secrets are
- [Authentication & Security](https://docs.clawbox.com/technical/authentication): browser login flow (unix_chkpwd), session cookies, gateway token, service tokens
- [AI Providers](https://docs.clawbox.com/technical/ai-providers): every provider lane, credential storage map, the two OpenAI lanes (both openai/, split by credential + Codex runtime), boot-time self-healing — OpenClaw/dual editions only; Hermes provider config is Hermes' own
- [Update System](https://docs.clawbox.com/technical/update-system): tag-based updates, channels (main/beta), divergence/"Updates paused", manual-update pitfalls
- [Agent Interface (MCP)](https://docs.clawbox.com/technical/agent-interface): the device tools the AI agent gets, the clawbox-cli.ts wrapper (invoked via bun; no `clawbox` command on PATH), auth model — the tool set differs by edition (app_* + coding family + coordinate browser control on OpenClaw only; skill_* + ai_* on Hermes only)

## Troubleshooting & Recovery

- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.clawbox.com/support/troubleshooting): symptom-first diagnostic ladders — can't reach the box, browser rejects password (SSH works), updates stuck, provider 401s, gateway token mismatch, Telegram
- [Recovery](https://docs.clawbox.com/support/recovery): ordered recovery options — password reset (sudo passwd clawbox), service restart, safe reinstall (hard-sync + install.sh), factory reset (password → clawbox, AP mode)
- [Forgot the Password](https://docs.clawbox.com/support/password-recovery): recovery with no password and no SSH — the password is always one of two candidates (wizard-set, or factory `clawbox` after a COMPLETED reset; a reset that failed partway leaves the wizard-set password in place), factory reset needs only a live session (not the password), and the one state that genuinely needs SSH
- [Updating ClawBox](https://docs.clawbox.com/support/updating): the supported update paths
- [FAQ](https://docs.clawbox.com/support/faq)

## Hardware

- [ClawBox Connect](https://docs.clawbox.com/hardware/clawbox-connect): Jetson Orin Nano model; ships with Google Gemma 4 E2B (QAT Q4_0) preinstalled on llama.cpp, ~29 tok/s, ~3.3 GB resident, offline with no API key
- [ClawBox Workstation](https://docs.clawbox.com/hardware/clawbox-workstation): DGX Spark model
- [Requirements](https://docs.clawbox.com/hardware/requirements): the shipped on-device model and its measured numbers, plus the Ollama bring-your-own table

## Using ClawBox

- [Messaging Channels](https://docs.clawbox.com/guides/messaging-channels): Telegram (device-managed, pairing-approved) and OpenClaw's wider channel support
- [Subscriptions](https://docs.clawbox.com/guides/subscriptions): ClawBox AI plans
